_note: The player's thought (ADR-052). Two of football's own values and one resolution, nothing per kind of option. goal_width_cm is Law 1. possession_value is what keeping the ball is worth against a goal (1.0): a side with the ball has a chance to score that a side without it has not; declared, to be derived at L3 from the engine's own matches. The chance a position gives is derived from the engine's own shot and save (kick.json, save.json) for an average shooter and keeper: the width of the goal the keeper cannot reach in the time the ball takes, against the spread of the shot's error. The forecast of who reaches a ball first samples its path every forecast_step_cm. The carrier's imagined football (step c, 2026-11-13): he imagines the others running at believed_speed (6.5 m/s) after believed_reaction (0.3 s): he does not know their characteristics (Plane B). A forecast with trust_ticks (1 s) to spare is sure; one with none is a coin he does not toss but weighs as half. The value of a space, in units of keeping the ball: (1 + how near the goal it is, as a share of the pitch) + its chance quality / possession_value; an option is worth its confidence times what it reaches, minus the rest times what the opponents would have there, weighed by his risk management. The lob (2026-11-13): he imagines its arc with the engine's own gravity (ball.json): it must pass over the keeper above the reach he believes a keeper has (computed: the reference keeper's height in save.json, his arms and an average jump in duel.json) and drop in before the keeper gets back. Anticipation (2026-11-13, plan L0-CLOSE 10b): how far ahead he imagines, between horizon_min_cm and horizon_max_cm; an option that ends farther than his horizon he cannot see through, and his confidence in it falls towards a coin he does not toss (half), the more the farther.
_source: Law 1 for the goal width. possession_value and forecast_step_cm: declared, arbitrary until L3; the chance a position gives is not a number of this file: it is computed from the shot and the save. horizon_min_cm and horizon_max_cm: arbitrary, declared, to be sourced at L3.
